author: The Infographics Show
description:
Every major tech bubble followed the same pattern. Railroads, telecom, dot-com. Now AI may be doing it again.

Big Tech is spending hundreds of billions on chips, data centers, and infrastructure, but the power grid can’t keep up. Some new data centers are waiting years just to get connected, leaving expensive AI hardware sitting idle while newer chips make it obsolete. Meanwhile, companies are taking on enormous leases, debt, and off-balance-sheet commitments to keep the AI race moving. History has seen this before.
During Railway Mania and the dot-com boom, investors poured money into infrastructure faster than demand could justify it. When expectations finally broke, trillions disappeared.

AI may transform the world, but that doesn’t mean every dollar being spent on it will survive.
